* Filter reset feature by @coltonbooth in https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/pull/500

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix Platform tab labels (en/fr) by @coltonbooth in https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/pull/512
* Fix resource type / scope code not lowercase in harvested metadata by @coltonbooth in https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/pull/513
* Refactor authentication providers and add Connected Accounts dialog by @JessyBarrette in https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/pull/502
* Fix notifyReviewer for sparse arrays and implement findCustodianOrgName by @JessyBarrette in https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/pull/509


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cioos-siooc/metadata-entry-form/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0
